title: Derived pullback of modules on schemes
statement:
Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with ring map $g^\sharp:g^{-1}\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal O_T$, and let $D(\mathcal O_S)$, $D(\mathcal O_T)$ be the derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category]. The *derived pullback* $Lg^*:D(\mathcal O_S)\to D(\mathcal O_T)$ is the composite of the termwise inverse image $g^{-1}:D(\mathcal O_S)\to D(g^{-1}\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (well defined because $g^{-1}$ is exact) with the derived change of rings along $g^\sharp$ on the site of open subsets of $T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]:

$$
Lg^*E=\mathcal O_T\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_S}g^{-1}E.
$$

It is computed by a K-flat resolution: for every K-flat resolution $\mathcal P^\bullet\to E$ of a complex of $\mathcal O_S$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] (one exists by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]), $g^{-1}\mathcal P^\bullet\to g^{-1}E$ is a K-flat resolution over $g^{-1}\mathcal O_S$, and $Lg^*E\cong g^*\mathcal P^\bullet=\mathcal O_T\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_S}g^{-1}\mathcal P^\bullet$, the termwise module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] (sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], as a complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]), canonically in $D(\mathcal O_T)$ and independently of the resolution.

proof.text: For an $\mathcal O_S$-module $\mathcal G$ and $t\in T$ the inverse-image stalk isomorphism gives $(g^{-1}\mathcal G)_t\cong\mathcal G_{g(t)}$, naturally in $\mathcal G$ [lem-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image-stalk]. Since exactness of a sequence of sheaves on $T$ is checked on stalks, $g^{-1}$ is exact; applied termwise it sends acyclic complexes to acyclic complexes and quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], and commutes with cones, so it induces an exact functor $g^{-1}:D(\mathcal O_S)\to D(g^{-1}\mathcal O_S)$.

source.place: Cohomology, Section Tag 06YI (label section-derived-pullback), Lemma Tag 06YJ (label lemma-derived-base-change), proof

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on the site of open subsets of $T$ to $\varphi=g^\sharp:g^{-1}\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal O_T$: it gives the exact functor $L\varphi^*=-\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_S}\mathcal O_T:D(g^{-1}\mathcal O_S)\to D(\mathcal O_T)$, computed on any K-flat resolution $\mathcal Q^\bullet\to\mathcal G^\bullet$ of $g^{-1}\mathcal O_S$-modules by $\mathcal Q^\bullet\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_S}\mathcal O_T$, with canonical comparison isomorphisms between resolutions. Hence $Lg^*=L\varphi^*\circ g^{-1}$ is a well-defined exact functor $D(\mathcal O_S)\to D(\mathcal O_T)$.

source.place: Cohomology, Section Tag 06YI (label section-derived-pullback), Lemma Tag 06YJ (label lemma-derived-base-change), proof

proof.text: Let $\mathcal P^\bullet\to E$ be a K-flat resolution [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. By step 1, $g^{-1}\mathcal P^\bullet\to g^{-1}E$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Apply [lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation] to the morphism of ringed spaces $(T,g^{-1}\mathcal O_S)\to(S,\mathcal O_S)$ given by $g$ with adjoint ring map the identity of $g^{-1}\mathcal O_S$: its pullback of $\mathcal P^\bullet$ is $g^{-1}\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_S}g^{-1}\mathcal O_S\cong g^{-1}\mathcal P^\bullet$, so $g^{-1}\mathcal P^\bullet$ is K-flat over $g^{-1}\mathcal O_S$. By step 2, $Lg^*E\cong g^{-1}\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal O_S}\mathcal O_T$, which is the termwise module pullback $g^*\mathcal P^\bullet$ [def-pc-module-pullback], canonically and independently of $\mathcal P^\bullet$ by the canonical comparisons of step 2. In particular $g^*$ carries quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes to quasi-isomorphisms.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma Tag 06YJ (label lemma-derived-base-change), proof, citing Lemma Tag 06YC (label lemma-pullback-K-flat) and Lemma Tag 06YG
